result.reason: The redline implements the preferred mutual cap and, if “Excluded Claims” is properly defined in Section 21.3 as the comment states, preserves the required uncapped carve-outs. However, the operative language supplied does not include the preferred mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. The margin comment cannot cure those omissions. The drafting is otherwise focused, though “total aggregate” is redundant and the carve-outs depend on an unseen definition.
